author: claude
summary: Task 004 of the voice-variant version-history plan: new API surface over app/domain/voices/variant_versions.py -- GET /api/speaker-profiles/{name}/versions (lists recorded versions, is_active flag, artifact_url) and POST /api/speaker-profiles/{name}/versions/{version_id}/promote (restores an older version's samples/artifact as live state and re-syncs speaker settings). Promote snapshots the outgoing live state first (same ordering discipline as task 002) before calling promote_version, and recomputes built_samples the same way SampleBuildTask does. No engine-ID branching added.

files.change: New router: list_speaker_versions (GET .../versions) and promote_speaker_version (POST .../versions/{version_id}/promote), following voices_actions.py's name-resolution + {"status": ...} response convention.
Registered voices_versions.router under the existing /api/speaker-profiles include_router block, right after voices_actions.router.

New test file: no-history-yet list response, missing-profile 404, list after two real builds (via the same stubbed-bridge/TaskOrchestrator harness test_voices_orchestration_integration.py uses) asserting version counts/is_active/artifact_url, and a promote test covering unknown-version 404, R1 revert-check (patched promote_version returning False -> 500, no side effects), and successful promote (active_version_id updates, live sample.mp3 byte-matches the promoted artifact).

flow_impact: voice-rebuild flow: version history recorded by tasks 001-003 is now reachable/restorable from the API -- a user (or future UI) can list a variant's recorded versions and roll the live sample state back to any of them.
